Respectful greetings to my teacher: 
Since leaving the mountain to study abroad, over a month has passed. My senior brother and I traveled through Xingtai and Quyang, witnessing various crafts such as stone carvings and white porcelain. The techniques were novel and exquisite, vastly different from those within the mountains. Later, we passed through Gaoyi, Julu, and Quzhou, where the terrain became increasingly barren and the heat made travel difficult. Moreover, the region was suffering from severe drought, so we constructed waterwheels and other farming tools to alleviate the hardship. Upon hearing of an ingeniously designed wooden sluice gate to the south, we planned to visit it.
Midway through our journey, we suddenly heard of the war in Hengzhou, where rampaging soldiers left bones bleaching the fields and corpses piled high. Elder Crane and our fellow disciples from Fenglong Academy have all joined the battle. The situation is akin to a critically ill person sweating profusely, teetering between life and death, yet no doctor arrives—such chaos and distress are unimaginable. After discussing with my senior brothers Jin Zheng, Lai Yuan, Fu Youzhi, and Zhang Yao, we resolved to head north to assist. Though we lack the courage to don armor and wield weapons, we possess ingenious skills and wish to use them to protect the people, bring prosperity, and eliminate harm.
As winter approaches, I send this message to you, my teacher, hoping you take good care of yourself and not worry about me.
